test_title: PYST 51: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: In an election between two candidates, 20% of the voters did not cast their votes, and all the votes cast were valid. The winner secured 70% of the votes cast and won by a margin of 23,200 votes. What was the total number of voters?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let total voters = x

Votes cast = 80% of x = 0.8x

Winner = 70%, loser = 30% ⇒ margin = 40% of votes cast

⇒ Margin = 0.4 × 0.8x = 0.32x

⇒ 0.32x = 23200 ⇒ x = 23200 ÷ 0.32 = 72500

**∴ Answer = 72,500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% did not vote ⇒ 80% voted

Winner = 70%, loser = 30%

Margin = 23200

**Formula used:**

Margin = (Winner% − Loser%) × Votes cast

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let total voters = x

⇒ Votes cast = 0.8x

⇒ Margin = (70% − 30%) of 0.8x

⇒ = 40% of 0.8x = 0.4 × 0.8x = 0.32x

⇒ 0.32x = 23200

⇒ x = 23200 ÷ 0.32 = 72500

**∴ The correct answer is 72,500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Voting Concept

Use only votes cast for percentage split

Margin Formula

Margin = difference in % × total votes

Percentage Conversion

Convert % to decimal for calculation

Key Insight

Work backward from margin to total voters
